extDescription.message: Shows Persian and Arabic text right to left, in the Vazirmatn font, on any site.

commandToggle.message: Turn on or off for this site

menuToggle.message: Dynamic RTL: turn on or off for this site

statusAuto.message: Off, the site is already right to left

allSitesHint.message: When off, it only runs on sites you turn on.

shortcutFirefox.message: Change it in Add-ons, gear menu, Manage Extension Shortcuts

shortcutSafari.message: Change it in System Settings, Keyboard, Keyboard Shortcuts

fontHint.message: Upload a .woff2, .woff, .ttf or .otf file, up to 8 MB.

fontBad.message: That file is not a font this browser can read.

sitesHint.message: Sites you toggle from the toolbar show up here. A rule also covers its subdomains.

clearConfirm.message: Remove every site from the list?

welcomeText.message: Persian and Arabic text on any site now reads right to left, in Vazirmatn.

welcomePin.message: Pin the icon from the extensions menu.

welcomeToggle.message: Click it to turn a site on or off.
